data.cultural_impact: The name "Kaltham" is culturally significant because it reminds us of the importance of communication in our daily lives. In Islamic tradition, spoken words carry immense weight and influence, and it is emphasized that one should use their words wisely and Kindly.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Kaltham" holds spiritual significance as well, as the tongue is believed to be a crucial aspect of one's relationship with God. Muslims are encouraged to recite the Quran and supplications with their tongues, and to use their speech to uphold the truth and practice kindness and good manners towards others. Additionally, the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is reported to have said, "The superiority of the strong person over the weak is only in virtue, and the superiority of the person who has knowledge over the uneducated person is like the superiority of the full moon night over the night when no moon is seen." (Bukhari and Muslim). So, having a name like Kaltham signifies the importance of using the gift of speech in a noble and virtuous manner, resembling the full moon's brightness in shedding light on one's faith and character.
